purpose: Route multilingual language-quality claims to independent human review while keeping machine-checkable invariants separate and making no inference about author provenance.
static_validation_scope: best-effort English known-phrase lint on declared public text surfaces
static_checks_do_not_establish: truth or adequacy of reviewer reasoning

public_claim_allowlist.text_lf:
Static validation cannot establish native fluency, native-language quality, cultural authenticity, native authorship, author provenance, reviewer identity or qualifications, model-output quality, or generated-video quality;
independent human review remains required.

review_policy.adjudication: Do not average a material disagreement away; revise the specimen and run a new independent review round.

cases.candidate_prompt: @Image1로 주인과 젊은 단골의 얼굴·머리·의상을 고정한다. @Video1은 카메라 이동 리듬만 참고하고 인물·장소·색조는 가져오지 않는다. @Audio1은 템포만 참고한다. 문 닫기 전 작은 식당. 광원은 계산대 위 형광등 하나만 사용한다. 주인은 말없이 단골이 두고 간 장갑을 종이봉투에 넣어 가방 손잡이에 건다. 카메라는 두 사람의 미디엄 숏에서 봉투 쪽으로 천천히 틸트 다운하고, 봉투 손잡이가 단골의 가방 손잡이에 걸리면 멈춘다. 대사 없이 환풍기와 종이봉투가 접히는 소리만 남긴다. 화면 속 글자는 생성하지 않는다.

adversarial_contract.failure: A reference token is translated, normalized, duplicated, reordered, or replaced with a lookalike byte sequence.
Locale fixtures reuse the same register decomposition or merely translate one generic template.
A cultural or aesthetic label appears without physical, audible, temporal, or relational realization.
A locale is signaled through generic props, prestige imagery, or media shorthand instead of situated craft.
A passing parser or fixture test is reported as proof of native fluency, cultural authenticity, or native authorship.
Repository-authored fixture text is reported as evidence about model responses or generated-video quality.
